register.title: Record of processing activities (Art. 30 GDPR)
register.draftNote: Template generated from the platform configuration. The controller reviews and completes legal bases and purposes, ideally with their data protection advisor.
register.tomsText: Tenant isolation in the database (row level security), encrypted connections (TLS), two-factor sign-in, roles and permissions, approvals for outbound actions, immutable audit log. Details: ME-IT's TOM document.
